headline: Phillies rout Orioles 8-0 in rain-shortened finale
recap: The Phillies routed the Orioles 8-0 in Baltimore on Sunday, a game called after six innings by rain. Philadelphia scored in four straight innings -- two in the third, two in the fourth, one in the fifth and three in the sixth. Bryce Harper and Bryan De La Cruz each homered, with De La Cruz driving in three runs. Justin Crawford went 2-for-3 with a double and two RBIs, and Alec Bohm added two hits. Zack Wheeler started but was lifted after two scoreless innings; Tim Mayza (3-3) picked up the win with two scoreless innings of relief, and Kyle Backhus closed it out. Kyle Bradish (7-10) took the loss for Baltimore.
The win extended Philadelphia's winning streak to two games. The Phillies are 59-53, second in the NL East, 8.0 games behind the division-leading Braves and 1.5 games ahead of third-place Miami.

Philadelphia opens a four-game series at home against the Washington Nationals tonight, with first pitch at Citizens Bank Park set for 6:40 PM ET. Aaron Nola is the probable starter for the Phillies; Washington had not named a starter as of this writing. DraftKings has the Phillies as -163 moneyline favorites.
